'''Russell Westbrook''' was a starting guard for the [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball]] team.
He was known primarily for his athleticism, in the form of high flying dunks in transition. A virtual no-name in his freshman year, averaging 3.4 points per game, his stats and his potential exploded in his sophomore year, when he averaged 12.5 points per game.
